LParameters plHabilita

Local lnI

If Type('plHabilita') # 'L'
	plHabilita = .F.
Endif

With Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista
	For lnI=1 to .Grupo_Op.ButtonCount
		If .Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).BaseClass = 'Commandbutton' And .Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).Visible
			.Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).Enabled = plHabilita
		EndIf
	EndFor
	.cmdFPOper.Enabled = plHabilita
	.Grupo_Saida.Sair.Enabled = plHabilita
EndWith

LParameters poForm, pnDataSes, pcEscolha

Local lcOperacao

Set DataSession to pnDataSes

Thisform.ParentForm = poForm
Thisform.PcEscolha  = pcEscolha
Thisform.ParentForm.Enabled  = .F.
lcOperacao = crSigCdOpe.Dopes

With Thisform
	.Caption = 'Status das Operações ' + AllTrim( Proper( crSigCdOpe.Dopes ) )
	.Top     = Thisform.ParentForm.Top + Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Top + 50
	.Left    = Thisform.ParentForm.Left + ;
			   Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Left + ;
			   Thisfo... [TRUNCADO]

Local lcOperacao, lnRecNo, loBrowse

lcDopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes

If Not IsEmpty(This.Value)
	xBrox = CreateObject('fwbuscaext',ThisForm.ParentForm.poDatamgr.pnIdconn,'SigStats','CrListaRemota','Cods',This.Value,'Seleção',.t.,'Cods')
	If  Not xBrox.plAchouRegistro
		xBrox.mAddColuna('Cods', '', 'Código', .t.)	
		xBrox.mAddColuna('Descs', '', 'Descrição',.t.)
		xBrox.Show()
	EndIf 
	This.Value = CrListaRemota.Cods
	Replace Descs With CrListaRemota.Descs in LocalStats
	This.Refresh
EndIf
Select Loc... [TRUNCADO]

Select LocalStats
If Not Eof()
	Thisform.lHouveExcl = .T.
	Delete
	Skip
	Skip - 1
Endif
Thisform.GradeSubN.Refresh

If Thisform.cmdInserir.Visible Or Thisform.cmdExcluir.Visible
	If ( Thisform.lHouveExcl Or Thisform.lHouveIns )
		Select LocalStats
		Go Bottom
		Go Top
		
		Select status,sum(1) as TT From LocalStats GROUP by 1 Into cursor Totais
		Select Totais
		Scan
			If TT > 1
				MessageBox('Status '+Alltrim(Totais.status)+' Digitado em Duplicidade!!!!',0+16,'Atenção')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndScan
		
		Select CrSIGOPSTS
		Zap
		Select LocalStats
		Scan
			Scatter Memvar
			If Empty(m.status)
				Loop... [TRUNCADO]

Thisform.lHouveIns = .T.

Select LocalStats
Locate for Dopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes And status = ' '
If Eof()
	Insert Into LocalStats (Dopes, CidChaves) Values (crSigCdOpe.Dopes,fUniqueIds())
EndIf

Select LocalStats
Thisform.GradeSubN.Column1.SetFocus
